target.statement: Total distance of the optimized route for Configuration 2 (5 K-means clusters, 10 iterations, GA mutation rate 0.10, 100 GA iterations) is 308.49 km, compared to the sequential reference route distance of 417.53 km.
target.dataset: 100 EV charging stations in Istanbul (lat/lon coordinates)

compute.basis: K-means and a small genetic algorithm on 100 points run in seconds; the main cost is installing Python packages and possibly fetching the dataset from the linked GitHub repo.

blockers: The GitHub repository may be incomplete or outdated; the exact random seeds and parameter settings for the GA are not fully specified, so exact reproduction of 308.49 km may require tuning.
The paper mentions using Google Maps API for driving distances, but the reported distances appear to be Euclidean; if the code uses the API, an API key would be needed.
title: Smart Routing for EV Charge Point Operators in Mega Cities: Case Study of Istanbul
